title: pleuranthodium floribundum
intro: Pleuranthodium floribundum, commonly known as the White Ginger Lily, is a plant species that belongs to the Zingiberaceae family. It is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Asia, prized for its medicinal and ornamental value. The health benefits of Pleuranthodium floribundum include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, relieving pain and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of the plant include gingerols and shogaols, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
